sections.changelog: v1.2.112: Fixes CSS Recipes editor sizing, adds WordPress-like rich content controls to Content Studio, speeds up Media Studio reopen with cached media/folder data, anchors collection context menus to the clicked row edge, persists floating Builder Tools panel width, clamps Structure restore/drag position, replaces the floating drag handle with an inline SVG, and scopes Bricks overrides to active MV floating states.
